title: Delivery Circuit Completion
description: An autonomous delivery drone needs to complete a circular route passing through a sequence of depots. You are given two arrays: fuel_generated, where fuel_generated[i] is the amount of battery charge generated at depot i, and fuel_cost, where fuel_cost[i] is the energy required to travel from depot i to the next depot (i+1). The drone starts with an empty battery at one of the depots. Determine the starting depot index from which the drone can complete the full circular circuit clockwise without running out of charge. If there is no such starting depot, return -1. It is guaranteed that if a solution exists, it is unique.
input_format: Two integer arrays fuel_generated and fuel_cost.
output_format: An integer representing the starting depot index, or -1.

examples.explanation: Start at index 3 (fuel 4). Charge becomes 4, cost to 4 is 2, remaining 2 + 5 = 7, cost to 0 is 3, remaining 4 + 1 = 5, cost to 1 is 3, remaining 2 + 2 = 4, cost to 2 is 4, remaining 0 + 3 = 3, cost to 3 is 1. Successfully returned to start.
No matter which depot you start at, the total fuel generated (9) is less than the total fuel cost (10), making a full circuit impossible.
Starting at depot index 4 allows the drone to successfully traverse all depots.
